"有！"

黑夜中，李青山点了点头道。

“啊？”

梦倩心中咯噔一下，脚下一个趔趄差点跌倒在地上，好在李青山及时伸手，一把将梦倩拉入怀中，这才止住跌倒的身子，柔软的娇躯入怀，李青山顿时有了想法。

紧接着。

便看到梦倩不满的目光望向自己道：“谁啊？”

“那多了去了！”

李青山想了想后，才开口道：“我估摸着，四五个吧？”

四五个？

“去你的！”

梦倩听到李青山的回应后，顿时气笑了，狠狠捏了李青山一把，搞得李青山倒吸一口凉气，双目猛然睁大。

在李青山看来，自己搀着的哪里是个人啊，就是个挠人心肝的小狐狸。

梦倩觉得李青山是在打趣自己。

要是李青山说了是谁，或者说有一个，甚至说有两个，梦倩都有可能觉得是真的，毕竟这个年代谈恋爱的很少，几乎都是相亲，自由恋爱也都是在同村，或者周围发生，而且十分保守，绝大部分有相好的，也都是有一个相好的。

等到后世，那一个人踩着好几条船的事情，在这个时代几乎不会出现。

至少在梦倩的认知中，没有这样的事情。

所以。

在李青山实话实说，有四个相好的时候，就认为李青山是在打趣自己。

“哎呀，我不能走了，刚刚崴脚了，要不你背我吧？”梦倩突然脸上露出一抹疼痛，装出一副楚楚可怜的尤物模样道。

“没事，我是中医，我给你掰回来。”

“不行，男女授受不亲，你一个单身汉，怎么能摸我一个黄花大闺女的脚呢，别废话了。”

梦倩话音落下，绕到李青山背后压着李青山的肩膀想要跳上去，却发现李青山的肩膀有些高，而且李青山站着了身体后，梦倩有些不太好跳。

顿时有些尴尬。

李青山一米八七左右左右，梦倩却只有一米六出头。

然而。

"Yes!"

In the dark night, Li Qingshan nodded.

"Huh?"

Meng Qian's heart skipped a beat, and she staggered and almost fell to the ground. Fortunately, Li Qingshan reached out in time and pulled Meng Qian into his arms. Only then did he stop falling. With her soft and delicate body in his arms, Li Qingshan suddenly had an idea.

Immediately afterwards.

Then he saw Meng Qian look at him with dissatisfaction and said, "Who is it?"

"That's too much!"

After Li Qingshan thought for a while, he said: "I guess four or five?"

Four or five?

"Fuck you!"

After Meng Qian heard Li Qingshan's response, she immediately laughed angrily and pinched Li Qingshan hard, causing Li Qingshan to take a breath and his eyes suddenly widened.

In Li Qingshan's opinion, the person he was supporting was not a human being at all, he was just a heart-wrenching little fox.

Meng Qian felt that Li Qingshan was making fun of her.

If Li Qingshan said who it was, or if there was one, or even two, Meng Qian might think it was true. After all, there were very few people falling in love in this era, almost all were on blind dates, and free love only happened in the same village or around them, and they were very conservative. Most people who had a crush also had a crush.

In later generations, the matter of one person stepping on several boats will almost never happen in this era.

At least in Meng Qian's knowledge, there is no such thing.

so.

When Li Qingshan told the truth that he had four good friends, he thought Li Qingshan was making fun of him.

"Oh, I can't leave. I just sprained my ankle. How about you carry me?" Meng Qian suddenly showed a touch of pain on her face and pretended to be a pitiful beauty.

"It's okay. I'm a Chinese medicine doctor. I'll break it back for you."

"No, men and women are not intimate. How can you, a single man, touch the feet of a young lady like me? Stop talking nonsense."

After Meng Qian finished speaking, she walked around behind Li Qingshan and pressed Li Qingshan's shoulders, trying to jump up. However, she found that Li Qingshan's shoulders were a bit high, and after Li Qingshan stood up, Meng Qian found it a little difficult to jump.

Suddenly I felt a little embarrassed.

Li Qingshan is about 1.87 meters tall, while Meng Qian is only over 1.6 meters tall.
